title: 第11章 是李清然的味道第12章 我们是来真实你的单女主叠甲
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
“啊？”
陈怀安一整个就是懵逼。
不是，真送来了啊？
小作坊都这么下料的？
还有，这游戏绝对是黑客搞得，这不实锤了？直接把他盒给开了！
寻常人遇到这种事第一反应必然是害怕。
但陈怀安不怕，他烂命一条，大不了就嘎，怕什么？
“喂！你们肯定躲在楼道里吧？出来说话！你们这游戏太氪了不能改改吗？我真没啥钱！”他对着漆黑的楼道一阵吼，回音顺着楼洞传递下去，无人回应。
“不出来算了。”陈怀安撇了撇嘴，呯的一声关了门。
他知道这些黑客不会出来，说那些话只是试探一下。
“我倒要看看怎么个事儿。”他坐在沙发上拆着盒子，心里还是有点好奇。既然对方会专门把游戏角色做的道具一比一定制送过来，那就说明对方对这个游戏确实非常上心，所以这礼物的质量肯定很高吧！
盒子里是个四四方方的香囊一样的东西。
做工很精致，然而陈怀安把这香囊翻过来一看，顿时没忍住抽了抽嘴角。
香囊上竖着写着三个繁体字——陈怀安。
下面还有一排小字：平平安安。
显然，这是个护身符，只是上面的字么……
陈怀安想说他刚上小学的时候字儿都比这好看。
这简直跟狗刨出来的一样，歪歪扭扭的，才感觉做工精致，一看这字瞬间没了档次。
“不过这里面装的是什么啊？”
他尝试打开袋子，但这材料比他想象的还要坚固，居然撕不开。于是为了初步确定里面装了啥他就凑上去闻了一下。

这一闻不得了。
一股淡淡的幽香就一股脑冲进了鼻子里。
不甜不腻，素雅淡然，没有一点侵略性，就像个默默诉说思念的女孩。
说不出来是什么香味儿，可他脑海中就自然地出现了李清然的身影。
他甚至产生了一股错觉，这上面就是李清然身上的味道！
“我，我去！”
陈怀安震惊了。有什么游戏居然能做到这个地步？
送礼物的游戏他听说过，什么女角色原味丝袜啥的他大学舍友就收到过，也有香味儿，但那不一样，那就是恶俗香水的味道，不会让人产生任何联想。这个平安符就完全不同。
他换了几种不同的姿势去闻，脑子里还是李清然。
哪怕打开小资料面对最喜欢的老师再去闻，脑子里依然是李清然。
“神了！”陈怀安一拍大腿。
不是哥们儿，你们有这技术在游戏里骗氪啊？
把游戏靠免费推广起来，成立一个香水品牌，这不得赚到盆满钵满？
最终，陈怀安还是选择把这个护身符带在身上。
无他，就凭这护身符确实给他一种是李清然亲制的感觉！
不到一上午，陈怀安就已经置办好一切。
医院楼下随便找个店剃了光头，癌症证明放在直播账号首页，又拜托医生帮忙拍了个励志vlog发了第一个视频，并咬牙投了一千块钱的推广。
中午找家面馆吃了三两干杂。
下午就坐上前往溙山的飞机。
content_en:
"Huh?"
Chen Huaian was completely confused.
No, it was really delivered?
Do all small workshops use this kind of materials?
Also, this game was definitely made by hackers. Isn’t this true? Just open his box!
The first reaction of ordinary people when encountering this kind of thing must be fear.
But Chen Huaian is not afraid. If he dies, it will be a big deal. What are he afraid of?
"Hey! You must be hiding in the corridor, right? Come out and speak! Is your game too expensive? Can't you change it? I really don't have any money!" He yelled at the dark corridor, and the echo passed down the corridor, but no one responded.
"Forget it if you don't come out." Chen Huaian curled his lips and closed the door with a bang.
He knew these hackers wouldn't come out and said those words just to test them out.
"I want to see what's going on." He sat on the sofa and opened the box, still a little curious. Since the other party will specially send props made of game characters on a one-to-one basis, it means that the other party is really interested in this game, so the quality of this gift must be very high!
Inside the box is a square sachet-like thing.
The workmanship was very exquisite, but when Chen Huaian turned the sachet over and took a look, he couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
There are three traditional Chinese characters written vertically on the sachet - Chen Huaian.
There is also a row of small words below: Ping Anan.
Obviously, this is a talisman, is it just the words on it...
Chen Huaian wanted to say that his handwriting was better than this when he first entered elementary school.
It's just like something dug out by a dog. It's crooked and it feels like it's exquisitely made. When you look at this word, it instantly loses its class.
"But what's in it?"
He tried to open the bag, but the material was stronger than he expected and he couldn't tear it open. So in order to initially determine what was inside, he went up and smelled it.
This smell is unbearable.
A faint fragrance rushed into my nose.
Not sweet, not greasy, elegant and indifferent, not aggressive at all, just like a girl silently expressing her longing.
He couldn't tell what the fragrance was, but Li Qingran's figure naturally appeared in his mind.
He even had the illusion that this was the smell of Li Qingran!
"I, I'm going!"
Chen Huaian was shocked. What game can actually do this?
He had heard of gift-giving games, and his college roommate received some original stockings for female characters. They also had a scent, but that was different. It was the smell of vulgar perfume, which would not make people think of anything. This peace charm is completely different.
He changed to several different positions to smell it, but Li Qingran was still in his mind.
Even if I open the brief information and read it in front of my favorite teacher, Li Qingran is still in my mind.
"Amazing!" Chen Huaian slapped his thigh.
No, buddies, do you have the skills to cheat money in the game?
Promoting games for free and setting up a perfume brand can make a lot of money?
In the end, Chen Huaian chose to carry this amulet with him.
Without him, this amulet really gave him the feeling that it was made by Li Qingran himself!
In less than one morning, Chen Huaian had already arranged everything.
I found a shop downstairs in the hospital and had my head shaved. The cancer certificate was posted on the homepage of my live broadcast account. I asked a doctor to help me shoot an inspirational vlog and posted the first video. I gritted my teeth and invested a thousand yuan in promotion.
At noon, I found a noodle shop and ate some snacks.
In the afternoon, I got on the plane to Lushan.
